name: National Soils Database (NSD) legacy observations
description: National soil-profile observation records with earlier paper, card and computer database stages.
story: The National Soils Database includes descriptions and laboratory results for about 1,500 soil profiles. Manaaki Whenua records that the collection was paper-based until 1980, when soil observations were entered into Datatrieve; it later moved to Paradox in 1993 and Microsoft SQL Server in 2000.

The site observations record conditions measured at particular locations rather than continuous soil-map polygons. The soil analyses, dates and original classification methods should be retained when those observations contribute to derived national spatial layers.
